name: Firozabad
registryBasis: The official Firozabad district land-record page places the revenue tehsil office in Firozabad city and links Uttar Pradesh BHULEKH records. The state cadastral-map digitization dashboard has a Firozabad tehsil row with linked/georeferenced map-sheet progress. This verifies city-linked land-record administration but not public vector access or point-level coverage. This is Firozabad, Uttar Pradesh, India, not Faisalabad, Pakistan.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: No public anonymous geometry-only feature endpoint/schema was verified from the official Firozabad/UP sources; no plot-specific query was submitted.
scopeLimits: Official Firozabad district page describes BHULEKH land records and identifies the related Revenue Department tehsil office in City: Firozabad. The state dashboard reports Firozabad tehsil cadastral-map digitization. Map viewers require revenue-village/plot selectors; no plot, Khatauni, or ownership-specific query was submitted. No public geometry schema verified.
remainingUncertainty: Citywide parcel coverage is not established. For the Florida row, retained geometry is from a countywide service and municipal-boundary coverage is unverified. For other rows, no broader completeness claim is made.
